fact: Biometric Update reports that Zimbabwe upgraded its national population registry in a reform begun around 2023 and concluded by mid-2025.
source_slug: 2025-07-15 Zimbabwe looks forward to digital ID rollout after population registry reform

fact: Biometric Update reports the upgraded national population registry was linked up with other important services to facilitate access, and that an integrated digital system will be based on it.
source_slug: 2025-07-15 Zimbabwe looks forward to digital ID rollout after population registry reform

fact: The Herald reports ZPRS is the official platform that stores and manages demographic data of all Zimbabwean citizens, including name, date of birth, sex, nationality, marital status, place of birth and residence, and national ID number, with an upgrade being finalised.
